categories.labelVi: Đường nghiên cứu (kính lúp + sổ tay)
categories.hint: Add the points printed beside each token's final row. Lost Temple glass scores by arrival order (earlier = more).

categories.label: Temple tiles
categories.hint: Sum of points shown on your temple tiles.

categories.label: Idols collected
categories.hint: 3 VP each, including idols placed in slots.

categories.label: Empty idol slots
categories.hint: Add the points printed on each idol slot that is still empty.

categories.label: Guardians overcome
categories.hint: 5 VP each, whether or not you used the boon.

categories.label: Item and artifact cards
categories.labelVi: Thẻ vật phẩm và cổ vật
categories.hint: Sum of points in the lower right corner of each item/artifact in your deck.

categories.label: Reached Lost Temple first (tiebreak)
categories.labelVi: Đến Đền Cổ đầu tiên (phân định hòa)

categories.label: Research score (tiebreak if nobody reached temple)

tiebreakers.description: Player who reached the Lost Temple first
If nobody reached the Lost Temple, highest research score

notes: family: point-salad-euro. Research track and idol-slot point values and Lost Temple order values are printed on the board and not listed in the rulebook text, so they are scorer inputs. Fear tiles belong to an advanced/variant rule (rulebook p.23). Solo mode vs rival not modelled. Expansion The Missing Expedition not modelled.
